title: Maanidan
desc: A charming flirt who has never been in a serious relationship with anyone finds himself in unfamiliar territory when he finally falls in love with a woman.

title: Silukkuvarupatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Gangers
desc: Saravanan, an undercover officer disguised as a PT master, confronts merciless criminals, unearths their fraud and recruits school personnel to dismantle their operation.

title: Kondraal Paavam
desc: The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.

title: Maharaja
desc: Prince Kohinoor returns home after twenty years only to discover that Ranbir Singh, his parents' killer, still holds control. Subsequently, he decides to defeat him to protect his loved ones.

title: Idhu Dhaanda Police
desc: Ramakrishnan, a police constable, is posted as a driver at Elathur women police station. He has to deal with the fiery sub-inspector, Arundhathi Varma, to save his job.

title: Bullet Raja
desc: Raja, a common man who falls prey to a flawed system and becomes a feared gangster. His friend Rudra joins him in his fight against the police, government and industrialists.

title: Mantra 2
desc: Mantra, an orphan, lives happily as a paying guest with an old couple. When some thieves break into the house and attempt to kill her, she learns an eerie truth about the family she is staying with.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kadal
desc: Unruly Bergman is expelled from his seminary when a kind-hearted fellow student, Sam, exposes his heinous acts. Soon he resolves to teach Sam a lesson that evil does predominate supreme.

title: Rum
desc: After a heist, Shiva and his crew hide out in an abandoned bungalow. However, they are soon haunted by spooky occurrences.

title: Milaka
desc: Azhagar, a young businessman, falls in love with Madurai. However, her three brothers constantly keep a watch on her activities.

title: Raja Raja Dhan
desc: Raja, a visually impaired young man, steps in to save Lucky from a gangster's deadly pursuit. Subsequently, touched by his unwavering courage and kindness, Lucky falls in love.

title: Brahmastra Part One: Shiva
desc: With Isha by his side, DJ Shiva rises to a crescendo of love and fortitude to embrace his role as the chosen protector of the universe's most powerful weapon.

title: Bharath Ennum Naan
desc: A graduate from Oxford is forced to take up his father's position as the chief minister after his sudden death. Later, he tries to reform the corrupt society but faces obstacles from his enemies.

title: Oru Nodi
desc: When a man goes missing under perplexing circumstances, a police inspector embarks on a quest to investigate the case, exposing a concealed network of political corruption.
